title: Utah law protects student privacy after BYU research found K-12 apps were collecting and sharing data
content_md: Sharman Gill reports: … BYU research finds that EdTech vendors don’t always meet their student privacy obligations; that research has led to new Utah legislation that tightens up the privacy issues.
